basic_details.job_title: Allahabad High Court Panel of Learned Advocates to argue/appear as Amicus Curiae for the criminal cases Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Applications for the High Court of Judicature at Allahabad (Allahabad High Court) 2026 recruitment for a Panel of Learned Advocates to argue/appear as Amicus Curiae for the criminal cases can be submitted from 15.10.2026 to 31.10.2026. Candidates must apply offline by submitting their applications on every working day at the earmarked counter at the office of J.R./D.R. (Admin.) Chamber, High Court, Allahabad (8th Floor, Annexe Building). Eligible applicants must have a minimum of 05 years and not more than 20 years of professional practice in the Hon'ble High Court, Allahabad, alongside a mini

qualification.details: The applicant must have a minimum of 05 (five) years of professional practice in the Hon'ble High Court, Allahabad. The professional practice of the applicant must not exceed 20 (twenty) years. Mandatory submission of details of the total number of criminal cases filed and argued (all the criminal case types) for the last 02 years in the Hon'ble High Court, Allahabad. The applicant must have filed a minimum of ten (10) criminal cases in each of the last two (02) years, with orders/judgement copies in the said cases. Mandatory declaration whether the above-mentioned criminal cases were filed and/or argued by the applicant in his/her own name, separately and independently, and not in the name of his/her Senior, before this Hon'ble Court at Allahabad.

selection_process: The official notification does not detail a multi-stage selection process or examination procedure beyond the empanelment eligibility criteria and submission of the prescribed application form forwarded by the competent bar authority.
important_instructions: The application form is available for download at the official website of Hon'ble High Court www.allahabadhighcourt.in. The Applicants may download the form and fill it up digitally in Font Calibre, Font Size 9.5. It is mandatory to fill all the details required in the form except the Form Number which is to be filled in during the submission of the final Form at the prescribed counter. If the Applicant has submitted "NO" as an answer to the Criminal Record History, they may not fill up the subsequent table seeking for description of Criminal Records. The Complete Form need to be forwarded by the Secretary/President Bar Council of Uttar Pradesh/ High Court Bar Association, Allahabad/ Advocates' Association, Allahabad. The Final Complete Form is to be submitted at the office of J.R./D.R. (Admin) Chamber, High Court, Allahabad [8th Floor, Annexe Building] at the earmarked Counter for the said purpose from the period 15.10.2026 to 31.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Allahabad High Court Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies.

rows.details: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
Panel of Learned Advocates to argue/appear as Amicus Curiae for the criminal cases
Minimum 05 to 20 years of professional practice in the Hon'ble High Court, Allahabad, with specified criminal case filings

content_sections.heading: About Allahabad High Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The High Court of Judicature at Allahabad has issued a notice under Chapter-XVIII-Rule 10 of the Allahabad High Court Rules 1952 to draw a panel of learned advocates to argue/appear as Amicus Curiae for the criminal cases in the High Court, Allahabad. Desirous applicants must fulfil specific professional practice criteria, submit mandatory details of criminal cases handled independently, and forward their application forms through the prescribed authority.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application form must be filled out digitally in Font Calibre, Font Size 9.5, printed on A4 size sheets, forwarded by the Secretary/President Bar Council of Uttar Pradesh/High Court Bar Association, Allahabad/Advocates' Association, Allahabad, and submitted at the earmarked counter at the office of J.R./D.R. (Admin.) Chamber, High Court, Allahabad (8th Floor, Annexe Building) on every working day from 15.10.2026 to 31.10.2026. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must have a minimum of 05 (five) years of professional practice in the Hon'ble High Court, Allahabad. The professional practice of the applicant must not exceed 20 (twenty) years. Mandatory submission of details of the total number of criminal cases filed and argued (all the criminal case types) for the last 02 years in the Hon'ble High Court, Allahabad. The applicant must have filed a minimum of ten (10) criminal cases in each of the last two (02) years, with orders/judgement copies in the said cases. Mandatory declaration whether the above-mentioned criminal cases were filed and/or argued by the applicant in his/her own name, separately and independently, and not in the name of his/her Senior, before this Hon'ble Court at Allahabad.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Copy of Bar Council Registration. 02 Years of Income Tax Returns (optional). Affix a recent Passport Size photograph at the specified place of the Application Form. The Applicant must sign the form & put their initials on each page of the enclosures. All the enclosures need to be printed in A4 Size sheets & attached in the order as stated above.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The official notification does not detail a multi-stage selection process or examination procedure beyond the empanelment eligibility criteria and submission of the prescribed application form forwarded by the competent bar authority.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The application form is available for download at the official website of Hon'ble High Court www.allahabadhighcourt.in. The Applicants may download the form and fill it up digitally in Font Calibre, Font Size 9.5. It is mandatory to fill all the details required in the form except the Form Number which is to be filled in during the submission of the final Form at the prescribed counter. If the Applicant has submitted "NO" as an answer to the Criminal Record History, they may not fill up the subsequent table seeking for description of Criminal Records. The Complete Form need to be forwarded by the Secretary/President Bar Council of Uttar Pradesh/ High Court Bar Association, Allahabad/ Advocates' Association, Allahabad. The Final Complete Form is to be submitted at the office of J.R./D.R. (Admin) Chamber, High Court, Allahabad [8th Floor, Annexe Building] at the earmarked Counter for the said purpose from the period 15.10.2026 to 31.10.2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the Allahabad High Court Panel of Learned Advocates Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an empanelment process initiated by the Allahabad High Court under Chapter-XVIII-Rule 10 of the Allahabad High Court Rules 1952 to draw a panel of Learned Advocates to argue/appear as Amicus Curiae for the criminal cases.

faq.question: Q2. What are the start and last dates to submit applications?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted from 15.10.2026 to 31.10.2026 on every working day.

faq.question: Q3. Where should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: The Final Complete Form is to be submitted at the office of J.R./D.R. (Admin) Chamber, High Court, Allahabad [8th Floor, Annexe Building] at the earmarked Counter for the said purpose.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required professional practice experience to apply?
faq.answer: The applicant must have a minimum of 05 (five) years of professional practice in the Hon'ble High Court, Allahabad, and such practice must not exceed 20 (twenty) years.

faq.question: Q5. How many criminal cases must an applicant have filed in the last two years?
faq.answer: The applicant must have filed a minimum of ten (10) criminal cases in each of the last two (02) years, with orders/judgement copies in the said cases.

faq.question: Q6. Must the criminal cases be argued in the applicant's own name?
faq.answer: Yes, there must be a mandatory declaration whether the above-mentioned criminal cases were filed and/or argued by the applicant in his/her own name, separately and independently, and not in the name of his/her Senior, before this Hon'ble Court at Allahabad.

faq.question: Q7. Who must forward the complete application form?
faq.answer: The Complete Form need to be forwarded by the Secretary/President Bar Council of Uttar Pradesh/ High Court Bar Association, Allahabad/ Advocates' Association, Allahabad.

faq.question: Q8. How should the application form be filled out?
faq.answer: The Applicants may download the form and fill it up digitally in Font Calibre, Font Size 9.5.
